title: Stir-Fried Shrimp with Citrus
description: A quick and flavorful Chinese dish made with succulent shrimp and citrus, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and ginger and stir-fry for 30 seconds.
Add the shrimp and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, until pink and cooked through.
Add the orange and lemon juice, soy sauce, and starch. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 1-2 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve immediately, garnished with citrus wedges if desired.
